ARCHITECTURE.md §9: src/mcp/** may import from modules/**/services only. It must never import a wearable provider adapter directly — it only ever reaches provider data through a module's service layer (e.g. modules/dashboard/dashboard.service), never through OuraProviderAdapter or any other provider.
ARCHITECTURE.md §9: src/mcp/** must never import lib/encryption directly — MCP never receives an OAuth token, encrypted or not.
